intl_finance.document: Copy of a recent official bank statement (if personal funds cover all expenses); if a sponsor pays any part, the Stevens Financial Verification Form completed and signed by you and each sponsor, plus an official bank statement, uploaded to the student portal
intl_finance.notes: Stevens strongly recommends (does not require) financial documentation with the application. The Financial Verification Form is required for the I-20 request: an incomplete form delays the I-20. The form is published for the 2026/2027 academic year and shows first-year expenses of $68,230 tuition and fees, $20,744 living expenses and $2,320 health insurance, books and supplies. The CSS Profile (code 2819) is for international merit scholarship consideration and is not a proof-of-finance document.

notes: Fact-check 2026-10-27: downgraded from 'none' to 'unknown'. The requirements list (source 1) says 'Essay (included on your application)', which does not say whether that is only the Common App personal essay; Stevens news has described Stevens-specific essay prompts in recent cycles and third-party guides report Stevens short responses and a 250-word essay for 2025-26 (not used as a source). No official page publishing or ruling out 2026-27 Stevens questions was found. Check the Stevens section of the Common App. 'none' rests on the first-year requirements list (source 1), which lists the Common/Coalition application, transcript, 'Essay (included on your application)', two recommendations and the fee, with no school-specific writing. The page does not name the cycle and was not dated; it states test-optional through Fall 2029. The FVF on file is for the 2026/2027 academic year; students entering in fall 2027 should check whether a 2027/2028 version replaces it. No published date for the financial documents was found.
